source: C. Vergne, FHNW & University of Basel, DOI10.5281/zenodo.24110229, CC BY4.0 data and MIT method scripts. 2023 digest DOI10.1109/INTERMAGShortPapers58606.2023.10228508. Source roster contains all89 published names/MD5. Initial native Zenodo API request failed DNS; official catalog provided the record's exact named files.
exposure: Published qualitative finding of no significant degradation, damaged row24 and example #24 metadata are already public to this analysis. The plotting anchor 0.9921, authored after both chamber acquisitions, has no documented exclusive training provenance. It is historical only. No scientific chamber cells or DC values inspected at freeze.
experiments: One PCB-mounted 8x8 array, 64 rows, preexclude author identified one-based #24. Conditional paired target comprises 63x3 raw outputs of the separate 7T-following zero-gauss chamber acquisition. One earlier 3T chamber available and both complete calibration coil campaigns. Baseline unexposed-board sources, all AC recordings, all Excel contents and all released fitted gain/offset outputs excluded. 7T responses refer to post-exposure bench calibration, not measured performance at applied 7 tesla. No human experiment or hardware safety inference.
input_contract: Exactly seven nominal currents −1.8,−1.2,−0.6,0,+0.6,+1.2,+1.8A for each of X/Y/Z physical remounts and both sessions; 42 actual CSVs. Each has 19,200 rows. Keep all 300 repeat observations per source chip in sample mean; 64-chip strides per original MATLAB. Validate 64-period identifier string alignment, record raw identifier patterns; refuse ambiguous join or incompatible shape. Compare 3T and 7T single chamber rows with published positional #24 exclusion; 64x3. Store min/max/SD and cohort means. Positive raw-unit scale is never chosen using observed target. Report native output units and only explicitly documented alternatives. Source MATLAB scalar current conversion0.5836 mT/A times alignment factor cancels exactly from the intercept as x levels are symmetric. Use all full-vector field slopes per nominal ampere; these are empirical response columns without an absolute field certificate.
model: For e=3,7, sensor s, pose a, observed 3-component vector y_e,s,a(I). Equal-time means within each current. c_e,s,a = intercept mean over the seven symmetric currents and M_e,s[:,a] = sum_I I y / sum_I I² (readout per A). Stack all 63 3x3 matrices to 189x3 M_e. cbar_e is mean over three pose intercepts. Common stray-field coefficients per pose give c_a=o+Mh_a. Absolute offset has the invariance o→o+Mq,h_a→h_a−q. Full-column-rank stack gives exactly 186 observable linear combinations under that model. Empirical angular pose/slope gradients, fixture or response changes and shielding residual can violate the model; rotations and exposure are not identified. Conditional estimate o_hat=cbar7−M7 M7† (cbar7−z3), borrowing only the projection onto the 7T response subspace of independent prior chamber vector z3. Compute using thin SVD, require effective numerical rank3 and condition number≤40 for both stacks; preserve and refuse on failure.
controls: all-pose isotropic common-axis correction U instead of M, with z3 gauge
same axial outputs used in author MATLAB; each axis centered at independent 3T chamber axis mean
literal publication figure axial demeaning plus 0.9921 for each axis (historical, excluded from matched joint gate)

paired-change multioutput ridge with 3T learned coefficients, using intercepts for all 3 poses and all vector slopes; apply z3+f(X7)−f(X3). Standardize from training sensors inside each leave-one-chip-out fit, select alpha in 0.1,1,10,100 by smallest aggregate 3T held-chip absolute-component RMSE, ties favor higher alpha; fit all63 for the locked forecast.
source_diagnostics: 3T leave-one-chip-out fit h_a on the other62 matched raw chamber readings to predict held chip offsets from its coil intercepts. Compare to common-axis h and raw calibration; per-pose residual and box of nonlinearities/uncertainties. Record principal angles between stacked 3T and 7T response subspaces, singular values, between-pose intercept mismatch outside range M, and chamber/coil raw ranges for source-only. Those source diagnostics inform interpretation, not selection. Mark conditional geometry unsupported if source fits fail to improve conventional model. Report regardless if numeric/identity gates pass.
outcomes: Raw conditional target all189 outputs, equally weighted RMS by axis and overall, mean chip Euclidean absolute error, worst component/worst whole chip, all competitors at worst candidate. Quantify observable and gauge-component error separately via P7, plus within-array-mean-centered errors as secondary. Primary success is beating every prospective same-information comparator in overall component RMSE AND persistence and isotropic control on every axis; historical +0.9921 is descriptive. One repeat of one device array after one sequential exposure history. No bootstrap or claim of independent exposures. Never use target chamber to learn mean/scale, align axes, select rows or fit. Complete predictions and source array digests durably locked before receiver.
